grantIds.title: Grant IDs
grantIds.description: Only return these grants (core project numbers like R01GM061721, or full numbers like 5R01GM061721-21). Leave empty for the whole list.

source.title: Source
source.description: live reads the current list; saved uses the copy bundled with the Actor (also used automatically when the live list can't be read).

asOf.title: As of (time switch)
asOf.description: Show the real list as it stood on this day (YYYY-MM-DD), read off each row's own disruption and restoration dates. For test runs. Leave empty for today's list.
